title: German Quiche
description: A German-inspired quiche made with eggs, sautéed vegetables, and vegan sausage.

ingredients.name: Vegan sausage
ingredients.notes: such as Tofurky or Field Roast

ingredients.name: Vegan milk
ingredients.notes: such as soy or almond milk

ingredients.name: Vegan cheese shreds
ingredients.notes: such as Daiya or Follow Your Heart

instructions: Roll out the vegan sausage and slice it into thin strips.
Sauté the onions, bell peppers, and mushrooms in a little bit of oil until tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, vegan milk, and vegan cheese shreds.
Add the cooked sausage and vegetables to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour the mixture into a pie crust and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the quiche is set.
Let the quiche cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
